brief:
The Prisoners' Media Office warned of deteriorating health conditions among Palestinian detainees held in Israeli prisons, citing an outbreak of scabies causing severe itching, inflammation, and painful wounds, Shehab Wire reported. The office said the condition worsens due to shortages of medicines and medical supplies.

The outbreak adds to longstanding complaints about inadequate healthcare and unsanitary conditions in Israeli detention facilities holding Palestinian prisoners.
